name_hi: बैंगन का तना और फल छेदक
symptoms_en: Tips of shoots wither (dead hearts); shoots and fruits have bore holes plugged with droppings; flower buds drop and leaves dry.
symptoms_hi: प्ररोह के सिरे मुरझा जाते हैं (डेड हार्ट); तने और फलों में छेद होते हैं जिनमें मल भरा रहता है; कलियाँ झड़ती हैं और पत्तियाँ सूखती हैं।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of brinjal
symptoms_en.quote: Withering of terminal shoots/dead hearts Bore holes on shoots and fruits plugged with excreta Shedding of flower buds Withering and drying of leaves

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of brinjal
management_en.quote: Remove the affected terminal shoot showing boreholes. Remove the affected fruits and destroy. Avoid continuous cropping of brinjal crop

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: Borer, Fall Armyworm, and Fruit Fly control: Spray Agniastra @ 3 litres / 100 litres water
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

management_en: Remove and destroy affected shoots and fruits. Avoid growing brinjal continuously in the same field. Install pheromone traps (12 per hectare). Spray neem seed kernel extract 5% from one month after planting.
management_hi: प्रभावित तने और फल हटाकर नष्ट करें। एक ही खेत में लगातार बैंगन न उगाएँ। फेरोमोन ट्रैप लगाएँ (12 प्रति हेक्टेयर)। रोपाई के एक महीने बाद नीम बीज अर्क 5% का छिड़काव करें।
source_notes: AI research (2026-10-07). Organic and cultural steps only are listed under management; chemical sprays in the sources are left out. Escalation advice is not sourced yet (TODO(agronomist)).
